comment: Chasm's sounds (docs/sound_plan.md). The game reports what happens by signal name; this table says what is heard. Saved while the game runs, it is reloaded within a second. The format is core/CueSystem.h's. Times (delay, jitter, gap, max_wait) are PASSES of the physics loop - 50 a second at any game speed, paused or not. distance and dx are from the listener, over the view's centre at half the camera's distance up (ApplicationChasmSound.cpp): someone under the middle of the view is 6 away zoomed right in, 17 at the starting zoom, 27 zoomed right out. Every rules event is signalled by its name (wiki/events.md: born, died, tree_felled, storey_raised, building_finished, harvest, settled, ...) with x, z, amount, person and building, so giving one a sound is a row here and no code. The rhythm of the work - how often a woodcutter swings, a builder's bouts - is in ApplicationChasmSound.cpp (SOUND_CHOP_SECONDS and the rest); here is only what each blow sounds like.

effects.comment: Everything but the music. Under the table's layer, sounds, whose gain is the settings' effects volume (ApplicationChasmMenu.cpp, ApplySettings).

world.comment: The colony's events at a place: a tree down, a storey up, a harvest - heard near the view.

activity.comment: The people at work, and the birds. Faded out and held while the world stands still - paused, the menu, the title, the statistics - and back in when it moves.

ui.comment: Clicks, placing, refusals and the notices' chime. Never held: a click answers in a pause.

ambience.comment: The world's own sounds - the water. Plays on in a pause, since time stopping does not stop a river; faded out under the title.

voice.comment: The people answering the player. Never held: an order given in a pause is answered there.

notice.comment: What the whole colony hears of, wherever the view is - the notice line's four, a birth, a death, a settlement: one chime at a time, and a second's quiet after it. Each waits its turn (busy queue) for up to three seconds rather than being lost.

place.comment: What happens at a place, heard near the view: a tree down, a rock broken, a storey up, a building finished, a harvest. At 4x a woodcutter fells every few seconds, so one chime at a time and half a second between, and the rest pass unheard.

voice.comment: Always about what the player did last: a new answer cuts the one being said (busy replace) - but a pick's (priority 0) never cuts an order's (priority 1). A group picked or sent answers in TWO voices at once (together), a man and a woman where it has both, one either side.

click.comment: A press on the HUD, whatever it does, or a tool taken up by its key.

placed.comment: The rules took a placement: a plot or cell painted, a storey added, a bridge, a field. Heard when it is made - in a pause, when the game goes on. A drag paints a plot or two a pass, so the gap makes a sweep a quick patter rather than a buzz.

refused.comment: A placement, an order or a crate refused - the line at the bottom says why. A drag across ground that will not take it is refused at every plot, so it is said once in a while, not each time.

nothing_to_take.comment: EVERY EVENT HAS THE NOTIFICATION FOR NOW (the user's, 2026-10-16), until each has a sound of its own - a row's sounds are all that will change. These four are the notice line's (Economy.h EVENT_*): no food or water for a scout to take, a pack run out, no tent to spare, a floatstone seam seen.

born.comment: The colony's own: heard wherever the view is.

grew_up.comment: Told on the notice line since 2026-10-16 (demo_plan.md step 6), so heard anywhere as the rest of the colony's own: someone grown up, a couple expecting, the frost taking a field (an event a field: skipped while the group sounds, so a winter's turn chimes once), the first boulder and the first on a balcony.

ranked.comment: RANKS (ranks_plan.md step 2): someone risen a rank by a kill, told on the notice line - the chime for now, as the colony's own are.

wall_broken.comment: WALLS BREAK (zombies_plan.md step 4): the chime for now, as every event has; step 4d wants a thud for each blow and a breaking for these.

goal_met.comment: THE DEMO'S GOALS AND ITS END (demo_plan.md step 7): the chime for now, as every event has; sound_plan.md wants stingers for these, from the score.

discovered_first.comment: AN AREA FOUND (areas_plan.md): the first of its kind - the first waterfall, the swamp - is told on the notice line, so it chimes with it, heard anywhere. area is its kind (Areas.h AREA_*: 0 river, 1 waterfall, 2 plateau, 3 forest, 4 mountain, 5 meadow, 6 swamp, 7 desert, 8 chasm), for a row of its own one day. Not the chasm, whose first sight is the music's (chasm_reveal).

chasm_reveal.comment: THE CHASM FIRST SEEN (area 8, AREA_CHASM): the score's war horn, its `reveal` stinger - MUSIC, not a sound: the `music` action sends it to the land's player (ApplicationChasmMusic.cpp), so apps/music says which file and how loud. It stands in for the chime.

winter_gust.comment: THE BIG GUST (weather_plan.md): winter's storm front reaching the view, once a storm, as the trees bow and the snow drives across - the score's `gust` stinger, sent to the land's player as `reveal` is. The game signals it again only after the view has been out of the storm (ApplicationChasmWeather.cpp); x, z and storm (0..1 at the view) come with it.

discovered.comment: Any other area found - a second river - is not told, and chimes only near the view, where it was seen, as a tree felled does.

tree_felled.comment: At a place: heard near the view as a blow is, panned with it - and not at all past 48, where it would be silent anyway: a silent play still takes a voice and the group's turn.

building_finished.comment: Made on the same tick as the storey that finishes it: priority over that one (busy interrupt), so the building is what is heard.

chop.comment: An axe blow: a woodcutter felling, on his own tempo. Only the nearest four are heard. Loudest under the middle of the view, gone 48 away; panned with the view, never hard over. The three files never play the same twice running, and each blow is pitched up to 6% either way (pitch_jitter) - so three takes sound like many. Past 0.1 a blow starts to sound like a different axe.

hammer.comment: A builder's nail, a blow of a bout of three to six. hammer_hit_1 is a quiet file, hence the gain.

chisel.comment: A joint being cut, a blow of a bout of two to four, quicker than the hammer's.

saw.comment: A pair of saw strokes, a bout on its own. Long, so two at most at once.

zombie_strike.comment: WALLS BREAK (zombies_plan.md step 4d): a zombie's blow at a palisade, a gate or a door - once a turn of its scratch, as its arms come down (ApplicationChasmSound.cpp, SignalZombies). `what` is HARM_*: 1 a palisade, 2 a gate, 3 a door, for rows of their own one day. Two takes (the user's, 2026-10-19), pitched up to 6% either way; the nearest four striking are heard. The takes are some 6 dB louder than the axe's, hence the gain.

punch.comment: A FIGHT (zombies_plan.md step 2): a bite landing, or a person's blow, each as the rules land it - `by` 0 a zombie's, 1 a person's. Three takes (the user's, 2026-10-19), pitched up to 8% either way; four at most at once, so a crowd round one man is a scuffle, not a drum roll.

bow_drawn.comment: THE BOWS (ApplicationChasmSound.cpp, SignalShooting): archer's creak (apps/archer, 2026-10-19), from a shot's nock - the arrow on the string - to its release, cut the moment the string goes, or when he gives the shot up. Any turn of the Shoot clip: at a zombie, or at the straw on the range's line. The nearest six drawing are heard; pitched a little, so a line of them is not one bow.

arrow_loose.comment: The string going: on the very tick an arrow at a zombie leaves the bow, and on the clip's release at the straw. Archer's take.

arrow_miss.comment: An arrow at a zombie that MISSES: archer's swoosh, its loudest part landing where the arrow comes down - `in` is the passes until then, sent every pass of the flight (forecast); once an arrow. Heard from where it lands. A hit is arrow_hit's. The range's practice arrows are not heard.

arrow_hit.comment: An arrow at a zombie going IN (the user's take, 2026-10-19): once an arrow, where it hit, on the pass it does - the third that fells one too. Pitched a little, so a volley is not one thud.

birds_flush.comment: THE BIRDS (birds_plan.md step 3): a flock that was sitting, scared up - the burst of wings, at its middle. Only within 48 of the listener (ApplicationChasmSound.cpp, SignalBirds), so no distance test here. One take, so pitched up to 8% either way. The colony's flocks follow the axe and are put up by it, which at 4x can be often: two at most at once.

bird_call_crow.comment: One bird calling: a BOUT of caws, not a single one - the takes are runs of three to five, kept as they are (the user's, 2026-10-18). When is the birds' own clock (Birds.h BIRD_CALL_*): now and then sitting, more often flying, and scared up the sentinel at once and a second answering. `voice` 0 is a crow: every flock but the wanderers. crows_1 is the loudest take by about 6 dB. Pitched up to 8% either way, so three takes sound like several birds. Three at most at once, never two starting together.

bird_call_magpie.comment: `voice` 1: the wanderers - ones, twos and threes - chatter as magpies (the user's, 2026-10-18), before magpies are a kind of their own. Quiet takes, about 10 dB under the crows', hence the gain.

river.comment: THE WATER HEARD (areas_plan.md): looping while a river is within 55 of the listener (ApplicationChasmSound.cpp, SignalWater). river_distance is from over the view's centre to the nearest water's edge - over the water it is the listener's height alone, 6 zoomed in, 17 at the starting zoom, 27 zoomed out - so a river under the view is loud and zooming out turns it down. river_hidden is how much of that nearest stretch is under the clouds, eased: unexplored water is heard faintly (the user's, 2026-10-16).

falls.comment: A waterfall's roar, archer's file: looping while a fall's lip is within 65. Heard further than a river, and faint under the clouds - a reason to go and look.

picked_leo.comment: THE PEOPLE'S VOICES (sound_plan.md, "Voices"): leo's takes for a man, leah's for a woman - `voice` 0 or 1 (ApplicationChasmSound.cpp, Say); a child says nothing yet. PICKED OUT - clicked, boxed, Shift-added, or his name pressed in a list: a greeting, never the same twice running. Spoken to the player, so not quieter further off - only panned a little: one person toward where he stands (`side`, ApplicationChasmSound.cpp SOUND_VOICE_SIDE_REACH), a group's two one either side. Every take is levelled to the same loudness when it is converted (tools/sound_ogg.py, speech/), so both voices take one gain. A double click is one answer (gap).

sent_leo.comment: SENT somewhere - a right click on the ground, or onto a tower as its guard. Answered when the rules TAKE the order (in its command), so a refused one is only `refused`; a group's nearest answers for it, and one more beside him.

gather_leo.comment: His card's chips: GATHER his pack first (a scout's provisions), or TAKE A TENT and go and found a settlement - or SETTLE in another one without.

released_leo.comment: ANY OTHER ORDER is an okay for now (the user's, 2026-10-16), until it has a line of its own - which is a row's sounds and no code, each order being its own signal: released back to his work (a post's or a tower's Release), a chip turned off (straight_on), his tent pitched where he stands, sent to pick fruit or draw water (forage; `what` 1 fruit, 2 water).
